name: Desh Rakshak Aushdhalaya Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1901, Desh Rakshak Aushdhalaya Ltd manufactures Ayurvedic and Herbal Products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
DRAL is the flagship company of Bhagwant Group and one of the oldest manufacturers of Pure Ayurvedic and Herbal Products. It has a wide range of ethical medicines that are derived from herbs and form part of this holistic healthcare system. The medicines are categorized into Proprietary & Classical Medicines. The company is currently manufacturing around 450 products which are GMP certified.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.38% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.85% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 428 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -14.2%
